speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, please describe your symptoms in detail. When did your fatigue, malaise, and unintentional weight loss first begin, and have you noticed any night sweats or fever?

speaker: Patient
text: 71-year-old male. The patient complains of fatigue and malaise over the last few months. He also reports an unintentional weight loss of 18.1 kg over the past 6 months. He does not recall any changes in diet or exercise routines that could explain the weight loss.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details; those symptoms are concerning for a malignancy. Given your age and the 18 kg weight loss, have you experienced any night sweats, fevers, or painless enlargement of your lymph nodes? Please also tell me if you have any cough, difficulty swallowing, or abdominal discomfort.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fatigue and malaise. I also have Significant unintentional weight loss, No change in diet or exercise.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Based on the significant unintentional weight loss of 18 kg and your age, we need to rule out serious conditions like lymphoma or lung cancer. Have you noticed any painless swelling in your neck, armpits, or groin, and do you have a chronic cough or trouble swallowing?

REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC) with Differential
REQUEST TEST: Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate (ESR)
REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_X-Ray
